scope: Only shared explicit manager transfer and existing HTTP/sync/registration manager adapters; registration general scope and whole RP06 not complete. No custom system-role binding, migrations or historical bulk repair.

D-S01-06.rules: Transfer only to an existing ACTIVE, nondeleted user with active membership of same alive project; never infer account activation, enrollment, or restore left membership. New member promoted to MANAGER unless already OWNER, preserve OWNER ownership. Previous manager MANAGER demoted MEMBER, OWNER remains OWNER, keep active membership/read rights. Requires current projects.manage_members and manage_members capability plus entry projects.update or registrations.update. Exact expectedUpdatedAt required for changed manager; no-base legacy409 rather than silent mutable assignment. One tx locks actor/target users sorted then project, rechecks current account/version/grants/project membership and expected row timestamp, applies manager+role transitions+fields+strict audit atomically; faults roll back all. Same unchanged manager no transfer side effects. Candidate admitted target active at command commit; later independent account deactivation is not automatic manager reassignment. Sync original v1 reservation records extra permissions/caps and calls same command; strict source baseline. Registration adapter manager path shares command now; generic registration scope remains RP06-T01, formal adapter acceptance RP06-T02 after dependencies.
